claims.claim: The canonical runtime separates retention, read, durable-write, disclosure, external-action, and cross-workspace authority.
claims.contract_artifact: Approved EPIC-004 AC2 and authority invariants
claims.comparison_method: Compare every declared authority row with its permitted and forbidden effects and verify that no authority implies another.

claims.claim: Exactly durable-full, durable-bounded, and session-only are accepted retention modes, and invalid values fail.
claims.implementation_artifact: context-policy.md, WORKSPACE.md template, strategy_workspace.py, and focused positive/negative unit tests
claims.comparison_method: Build and validate the default session-only workspace, then mutate the mode to an invalid value and require WORKSPACE_RETENTION_MODE.

claims.claim: Authority-schema tests reject missing disclosure or other authority declarations and runtime policy forbids implied copying or action.
claims.implementation_artifact: strategy_workspace.py authority validation and context-policy authority matrix
claims.comparison_method: Mutate the disclosure declaration, require WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_SCHEMA, and inspect the runtime matrix for non-implication.
invalid_substitutes: Read access treated as write or disclosure authority
